entries.purpose: Authoritative operational alert, grouping, analyst-state, job, notification, enrichment, incident, PCAP, and analysis state.
entries.schema_version_contract: alert_store_metadata persists aggregate schema version 1; startup rejects invalid or newer versions and controlled evaluation requires the exact supported version.
entries.migration_strategy: Runtime PRAGMAs settle before one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction owns schema admission, additive DDL, compatibility backfills, consistency rebuilds, and final version persistence; destructive changes require a separately reviewed export, rollback, and recovery plan.
entries.rollback_strategy: Stop all writers, preserve the current database and sidecars, restore a verified prior snapshot, then rebuild derived group summaries before admission.
entries.backup_schedule: Verified online SQLite backup every hour plus one complete runtime recovery bundle daily at 02:30 local time.
entries.backup_secret_policy: The daily database artifact is authenticated and encrypted before atomic bundle publication; its versioned key remains in macOS Keychain and operator escrow, never in the bundle, process arguments, environment, logs, or source control. Hourly local repair snapshots remain owner-only and are not approved for off-host replication.
entries.retention: Ten hourly SQLite backups and seven daily recovery bundles by default; failed recovery candidates are retained for operator disposition.
integrity_checks: PRAGMA quick_check on live and backup copies
PRAGMA foreign_key_check on daily snapshots and logical restores
partial_write_controls: atomic durable-job and alert commit workflows
duplicate_controls: unique job type and dedupe key
queue consistency and shadow reconciliation checks
orphan_controls: alert-group summary orphan and missing-summary checks
maintenance: hourly verified backup and summary consistency pass
restore_validation: isolated copy quick and foreign-key checks
logical in-memory restore and row-count comparison
transient WAL and SHM sidecar refusal
provenance_controls: raw normalized alert payloads remain bound to stable alert and group identifiers
analysis and incident records retain source identifiers and generated timestamps
restore manifests bind snapshot hashes and authoritative row counts

entries.purpose: Authoritative bounded investigation runs, event hash chains, evidence references, hypotheses, decisions, model/tool calls, and reservations.
entries.schema_version_contract: harness_metadata persists schema_version 5 and startup rejects databases created by a newer runtime.
entries.migration_strategy: Additive schema settlement runs inside one SQLite connection transaction after probing the existing version; newer schemas fail closed.
entries.rollback_strategy: Restore a verified owner-only snapshot only while the harness is stopped; never restore active browser sessions or mix database and ledger generations.
entries.backup_schedule: Included in the daily 02:30 runtime recovery bundle when present; maintenance requires a fresh verified backup before retention deletes terminal runs.
backup_artifacts: harness-maintenance backup referenced by the maintenance receipt
entries.backup_secret_policy: The database stores bounded sanitized trace metadata and evidence references; its daily artifact is authenticated and encrypted with the versioned macOS Keychain recovery key before publication.
entries.retention: Daily bundles retain seven generations by default; hourly harness retention removes only bounded terminal runs after a verified backup.
integrity_checks: terminal event and ledger hash-chain verification
partial_write_controls: idempotency keys and fenced run reservations
growth_monitoring: allocated and live page bytes in operational SLOs
maintenance: safe WAL truncate only after complete checkpoint
provenance_controls: hash-chained events retain stable evidence references
terminal manifests bind model, tool, hypothesis, decision, and event ledgers
restore validates run counts and schema before use

entries.owner: Mac Studio n8n workflow database owner
entries.purpose: Authoritative n8n workflow definitions, credentials encrypted by n8n, execution metadata, projects, and runtime configuration state.
entries.schema_version_contract: Schema versions and migrations are owned by the pinned n8n release and recorded in n8n migration tables.
entries.migration_strategy: Run only the pinned n8n image's supported forward migrations after a verified export and database dump; application code does not issue ad hoc n8n DDL.
entries.rollback_strategy: Restore the pre-upgrade custom-format dump and matching n8n encryption/configuration state, then run the exact prior pinned image.
entries.backup_schedule: Custom-format PostgreSQL dump in the daily 02:30 runtime recovery bundle and before every n8n version migration.
entries.backup_secret_policy: The database dump and matching n8n encryption configuration are separate authenticated ciphertexts bound by one content-free manifest. The versioned recovery key remains in macOS Keychain and operator escrow; neither plaintext nor key is admitted to source control.
entries.retention: Seven complete daily recovery bundles by default, with a separate pre-migration rollback generation retained through acceptance.
integrity_checks: isolated restore with public-table and workflow row checks
partial_write_controls: PostgreSQL transaction semantics managed by n8n
graceful worker drain before upgrade or restore
matching encryption configuration required for recovery
restore_validation: public schema table and workflow row checks
provenance_controls: workflow and execution identifiers remain inside the restored relational schema
bundle manifest binds dump and configuration generations
restores require the matching pinned n8n image

entries.purpose: Optional durable-job shadow plus authoritative asset, DHCP, Software Inventory, and AC Hunter normalized stores.
entries.schema_version_contract: Each onion_sentinel_queue, onion_sentinel_assets, onion_sentinel_software, and onion_sentinel_ac_hunter component persists and validates schema version 1.
entries.migration_strategy: Versioned SQL schemas use transactional BEGIN and COMMIT blocks; runtime stores reject unsupported versions and production cutovers require reconciliation.
entries.rollback_strategy: Disable PostgreSQL-backed features, restore the verified prior custom-format dump into an isolated container, reconcile against SQLite authority where applicable, then re-enable.
entries.backup_schedule: Optional custom-format PostgreSQL dump in the daily 02:30 recovery bundle whenever any alert-store PostgreSQL feature is enabled.
entries.backup_secret_policy: The normalized application-state dump is authenticated and encrypted before publication. Database credentials remain in the separately governed runtime environment and the versioned recovery key remains in macOS Keychain and operator escrow.
entries.retention: Seven daily recovery bundles by default; software and AC Hunter schemas additionally retain bounded active/history snapshots.
integrity_checks: SQLite shadow count and digest reconciliation
isolated durable-job schema and row admission
partial_write_controls: source-revision fencing for durable-job shadow projection
duplicate_controls: unique durable job type and dedupe key
growth_monitoring: PostgreSQL backup age and disk-capacity SLO
provenance_controls: software records retain evidence, source, asset, and observation identifiers
shadow jobs retain SQLite identity and source revision
AC Hunter snapshots retain authoritative dataset digests

entries.purpose: Relay-side Security Onion alert deduplication and durable delivery outbox, including retry and dead-letter state.
entries.schema_version_contract: The installed Relay source defines the seen-alert and delivery-outbox schema, but the database does not yet persist one schema version.
entries.migration_strategy: Additive CREATE TABLE and CREATE INDEX startup statements preserve existing rows; incompatible changes require a stopped-Relay copy migration and verified rollback archive.
entries.rollback_strategy: Stop Relay timers, restore the encrypted runtime archive into an isolated root, verify manifest and SQLite integrity, then restore the prior source and state together.
entries.backup_schedule: Encrypted operator-controlled backup before repair, OS upgrade, storage replacement, or application update, with an isolated restore drill after material changes and at least quarterly.
backup_artifacts: encrypted Relay runtime archive containing opt/so-alert-relay/state/seen.sqlite3
content-free archive manifest with SHA-256 digests
entries.backup_secret_policy: The encrypted runtime archive contains state and separately protected keys; its content-free manifest never records database rows or credential material.
entries.retention: Delivered outbox rows retain 30 days by default; backup generations follow the operator-controlled encrypted-backup retention policy.
integrity_checks: PRAGMA quick_check on every isolated restored state database
orphan_controls: invalid stored payloads move to dead letter
outbox status counts in Relay health
growth_monitoring: Relay root and spool capacity thresholds
outbox pending and dead-letter health counts
maintenance: operator restore drill after material change and quarterly
restore_validation: encrypted archive extraction into an isolated root
SQLite quick check before Relay timers are enabled
provenance_controls: Security Onion alert identifiers remain outbox idempotency keys
delivery payloads stay bound to their alert identifiers
manifest hashes bind restored state without exposing its rows
